Stop forgetting brew update && brew upgrade. A menu bar app that keeps your Homebrew packages fresh — automatic checks, one-click updates, z...

repo_meta_data.description: Free, open-source Mac app updater and MacUpdater alternative. Finds updates from the App Store, Sparkle, Electron and Homebrew, verifies each download, installs in one click.
